title: App Endpoints
description: Every HTTP endpoint of your apps (job apps), discovered automatically from the route/path label.

list.name: container
list.label: Containers (regex)
list.description: Regex on container names whose CPU/memory/logs are shown, e.g. my-api-.*

list.name: probe
list.label: Health URL (regex)
list.description: Regex on the health URL probed by blackbox (prometheus/sites.yml), e.g. .*my-api:8080/healthz.*

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[5m])) * 100 or vector(0)

panels.title: Endpoints
panels.description: Distinct endpoints that received at least one request since the app started.

panels.title: Services measured
panels.description: Services with HTTP metrics in this range: from Beyla (eBPF) or from the app's own /metrics.

panels.title: Health probe
panels.description: blackbox probe of the health URL (prometheus/sites.yml).

panels.title: Endpoints (all routes, over the selected time range, slowest first)
Endpoints

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (route, path, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, path, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (route, path, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[$__range])))

(sum by (route, path) (rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (route, path) (rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (route, path) (rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 100

(sum by (route, path) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (route, path) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0)

(sum by (route, path) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"2.."}[$__range])) or sum by (route, path) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0)

(sum by (route, path) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"3.."}[$__range])) or sum by (route, path) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0)

(sum by (route, path) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (route, path) (increase(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0)

panels.description: Every endpoint over the selected time range: request count split by 2xx / 3xx / 4xx / 5xx, 5xx share, and latency p50 / p95 / p99. Sorted by p95, slowest first.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, path, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[5m]))))
sum by (route, path) (rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (route, path) (rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[5m])) * 100

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Where requests land in time. A band near the top = some requests take very long (possibly hanging).

targets.expr: container:~"${container:raw}" level:~"error|fatal|panic|warn.*" | sort by (_time desc) | limit 500

panels.title: Status codes per endpoint
panels.description: Exact HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 401, 404, 500, ...) per endpoint over the selected time range.

panels.title: Apdex (T=250ms)
panels.description: User satisfaction 0..1: under 250 ms = satisfied, under 1 s = tolerating (counts half), slower = frustrated. Needs le=0.25 and le=1 buckets.

panels.title: Requests vs last week
panels.description: Traffic now vs the same hour a week ago. Empty until a week of data exists.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[1h]))) / histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="apps", service=~"$service"}[1h] offset 1w))) * 100 - 100

panels.title: 4xx and 5xx/s by endpoint (top 10)
panels.description: Which endpoints return client and server errors, and which code.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (route, status) (rate(http_requests_total{job="apps", service=~"$service", status=~"[45].."}[5m])))

panels.title: Top error messages
panels.description: The most frequent error log lines of the service (JSON logs: msg / error fields). Empty: No errors

targets.expr: container:~"${container:raw}" level:(error OR fatal OR panic) | unpack_logfmt fields (msg, err, error) keep_original_fields | format if (msg:"") "<_msg>" as msg | stats by (msg, err, error) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)
